import bpy,json
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
out=[]
for o in bpy.data.collections['Terminal_Craft'].objects:
 if o.type!='MESH':continue
 mat=o.matrix_world
 bb=[mat@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
 lo=[min(q[i] for q in bb) for i in range(3)];hi=[max(q[i] for q in bb) for i in range(3)]
 if ((lo[0]<-4.2 and hi[0]>-4.7) or (lo[0]<-2.1 and hi[0]>-2.6)) and lo[1]<-2.25 and hi[1]>-2.8 and lo[2]<.18 and hi[2]>.01:
  out.append({'name':o.name,'min':lo,'max':hi,'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials if m]})
print(json.dumps(out))
